stem: According to the passage, what helps cool the air around trees?
options: The growth of young trees without regular care
The absorption of water by nearby paved surfaces
The release of water vapour through their leaves
The replacement of all other heat responses by tree cover

verdicts.working: The passage states that trees release water vapour through their leaves, which can cool the surrounding air.
